newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Iraqi U.N. envoy hopes U.S. policy will change.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi U.N. envoy hopes U.S. policy will change.

text.p: Iraqi U.N. Ambassador Nizar Hamdoon, whose country has been a constant target of U.S. Ambassador Madeleine Albright, hopes Washington's policy will change once she becomes Secretary of State.

"I'm full of hope right now that we see a change in American policy, which is obviously determined at the top administration levels," Hamdoon said in a telephone interview after President Bill Clinton nominated Albright to head the U.S. State Department in his second term.
He declined to reminisce about his encounters with Albright, saying the issue was not one of personalities but of government policy.
"We are hopeful to see some changes, especially regarding Iraq," he said.
Asked what changes he would like to see, he replied: "When there is a trend for change in policy, I don't think it will be difficult to guess what Iraq would really like to see."
A long-standing Iraqi objective is to secure the lifting of U.N. economic sanctions that have been in force since President Saddam Hussein's troops invaded Kuwait in August 1990.

The United States, through Albright, has taken the lead in ensuring the sanctions remain in force until Security Council resolutions requiring the scrapping of Iraq's weapons of mass destruction, and other measures, are fulfilled to the letter.
Hamdoon declined to speculate on how Albright would perform as Secretary of State. Asked if he had a message for her, he replied: "Not really."
Albright once called a 1994 address by Iraqi deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz the "most ridiculous speech ever given by Iraq at the United Nations."

She has repeatedly accused Saddam of being the Iraqi people's worst enemy, trampling their human rights and spending millions of dollars building luxurious mansions for his cronies while ordinary Iraqis suffer the effects of sanctions.
In response to being called a serpent by the Iraqi press, she delighted in wearing a brooch in the shape of a snake.
